titleStmt.author: Jean Berne-Bellecour

body.head: Souvenirs de l'armée américaine en France / Souvenir of the American Army in France
body.author: Jean Berne-Bellecour
body.p:
A Monsieur le Président Raymond Poincaré
En Respectueux hommage.
J. Berne Bellecour.
1919
... and it was not a dream!...

His calvary
For the salvation of the world

Two friends
French poilu and American officer
Someone always on the look out

All that can be seen of the front line trenches
during the enemy bombardment
Playing to cards under the shells
Searching the German dead after the capture of a trench

German dead lying in the barbed wire
before the American front

Brothers in arms
French dragon and American officer

French gun in action
(front of Champagne)

Au lecteur
